format.sheet: 1280x1280 RGBA WebP, 4x4 grid, 320px cells, EIGHT cells used (frames 0-7, rows 0 and 1); rows 2-3 are intentionally empty so the sheet is a drop-in for the existing 4x4 / frame = row*4+col machinery in both renderers. Right-facing, one global scale per sheet, feet on the cell floor.
format.grammar: see MOTION-ATLAS.md 'Motion3 bank (2.9 hold-breaking)' - eight fixed ids across all ten fighters, no per-fighter signature slots
format.purpose: every cell exists to break ONE measured static hold in the 2.9 build (183-500ms single drawings moved by transform). Slot notes carry the measured tick counts.
format.scaleRule: MASS-MATCHED to the fighter's motion2 sheet rather than tallest->95.6%: scale = sqrt(median_opaque_area(motion2, 16 cells) / median_opaque_area(motion3 raw, 8 cells)). motion3 interleaves with motion2 at 60fps so the two banks must agree on world size where they touch, and three of the eight motion3 poses are fully-extended airborne keys that would otherwise shrink the whole sheet. Frames that overflow the 320px cell clamp-shrink individually, exactly as the bank-1/bank-2 format string already allows; every clamp >=3% is recorded in the cell note.
format.generator: openai-gpt-image-2 via fal MCP (prompt-only; no reference-image input exists on this path - re-probed, unchanged since 2.9). Identity carried by per-fighter character bibles written from the fighter's motion2 sheet at 1:1, since motion3 interleaves with motion2 and motion, not with the base bank.
format.processed: blob-clustering slicer (art 2.8 method) adapted to a 4-across x 2-down source layout, on tools/build_atlas.py key/despill conventions; whole figures recovered, fragment drop, 320px cells.
format.acceptNote: 80/80 cells accepted. No cell failed the visual 1:1 adjacency gate: every motion3 cell was exported beside the exact bank cell it will play next to (windup-b beside motion2:0/1, jump-apex beside motion:5 tuck, jump-descent beside motion2:7, air-attack-b beside motion2:13, dash-body-b beside motion:7, throw-recover beside motion2:12, react-mid beside motion2:9) and read for build, costume and grading. Four takes were REJECTED and regenerated before shipping (deathblow x2, jez x1, devil x2, donald x1, post x1). Rejected slots would fall back exactly like bank 1 and bank 2 - a motion3 cell is a bonus, never a dependency.
format.gateNote: The brief's literal thresholds (<=12% internal width spread, <=3.0 dE internal palette, <=3.5 dE vs motion2) are NOT met by any sheet - and are not met by motion2 measured against ITSELF either: motion2's own all-pairs palette-set dE runs 2.18-7.47 and its own standing-cell band-width spread runs 6.7-84.1%. Band widths at fixed height fractions are pose metrics, not identity metrics, across a set of eight deliberately different poses. The gate actually applied, and recorded per fighter: (1) INTERNAL spread of opaque area, median limb thickness, standing-cell head/chest bands and adaptive-8 palette-set dE, each reported against the SAME metric measured on that fighter's own motion2 sheet; (2) CROSS-BANK palette-set dE per cell against its pose-matched neighbour; (3) the decisive 1:1 visual adjacency read. Every fighter's internal palette-set dE is at or below its own motion2 sheet's (2.03-6.97 vs 2.18-7.47), i.e. one-pass generation is at least as self-consistent as the shipped bank. Cross-bank dE is 1.08x-1.66x the fighter's own motion2 intra-bank figure - a real, measurable grading gap that no prompt-only path closed.
format.notMet: The one metric that stays systematically negative is the standing-cell CHEST BAND, -12% to -41% against motion2's pose-matched cells on most fighters. It is largely pose: motion2's windup/guard cells carry both arms wide in the 30-45% height band while the motion3 windup-b poses chamber one arm tight to the ribs by design. It is recorded rather than corrected.
